create_layoutlm_config: create a LayoutLMConfig instance with default model configuration parameters
build_layoutlm_model: build a LayoutLMModel with random weights from a LayoutLMConfig configuration
customize_layoutlm_config: customize a LayoutLMConfig with custom hidden_size, num_hidden_layers, and vocab_size values
access_model_config: access the model configuration from an instantiated LayoutLMModel via model.config
init_layoutlm_from_checkpoint: initialize a LayoutLMConfig using the microsoft/layoutlm-base-uncased checkpoint
